name: PSReadLine
summary: PowerShell's command-line editor: token colouring, predictive IntelliSense (inline or list), history search, emacs/vi/windows key modes and custom key handlers.
configFormat: PowerShell code in the profile ($PROFILE): Set-PSReadLineOption / Set-PSReadLineKeyHandler
startupCostMs: Measured on this Windows 11 machine (Windows PowerShell 5.1, median of 5, `powershell -NoProfile -Command "Import-Module PSReadLine -RequiredVersion X"` minus a bare `-Command 1` baseline of ~170 ms): 2.0.0 adds ~50 ms, 2.4.5 adds ~67 ms. Per-keystroke cost is negligible (compiled .NET).

install.notes: Windows PowerShell 5.1: Install-Module PSReadLine -Scope CurrentUser -Force (the engine adds -AllowClobber). If PowerShellGet complains about the publisher/signature of the built-in 2.0.0, add -SkipPublisherCheck (not needed on this machine).
PowerShell 7 ships a recent PSReadLine already; update only if you need a newer one.

windows.notes: Windows PowerShell 5.1 ships PSReadLine 2.0.0: no prediction colours, no -PredictionViewStyle/ListView; predictions need >= 2.1 (HistoryAndPlugin and ListView need >= 2.2). Check `(Get-Module PSReadLine).Version` first. Machine check: with 2.4.5 in the CurrentUser module path (Documents\WindowsPowerShell\Modules) and 2.0.0 in Program Files, `Import-Module PSReadLine` loads 2.4.5. Setting -PredictionSource fails with 'console output doesn't support virtual terminal processing or it's redirected' when run non-interactively. PowerShell 7 profile path is {pwsh-profile}; 5.1 is {ps-profile}. History file: %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\PSReadLine\ConsoleHost_history.txt.

install.notes: Only to update past the version bundled with PowerShell 7 (brew install --cask powershell).

macos.notes: Part of PowerShell 7 on every OS. EditMode defaults to Emacs on non-Windows. History: $HOME/.local/share/powershell/PSReadLine/ConsoleHost_history.txt (or $XDG_DATA_HOME).

install.notes: Only to update past the bundled version.

linux.notes: Part of PowerShell 7. EditMode defaults to Emacs.

suggestions.notes: Predictive IntelliSense: inline or list view; needs PSReadLine 2.1+ (2.2+ for list view and plugins).
